title: Quy chuẩn kỹ thuật quốc gia về báo hiệu đường bộ QCVN 41:2024/BGTVT (ban hành kèm theo Thông tư 51/2024/TT-BGTVT)
notes: Road sign and marking standard. Answers 'what does sign P.124 mean' and 'may I cross a solid line', which the penalty decree presupposes but never defines. Text comes from the luatvietnam.vn Word edition (downloaded manually; the regulation only, without the wrapper of Thông tư 51/2024/TT-BGTVT). The official Công báo PDFs (see source_urls) are not kept in the repository; their drawing pages have almost no text layer.
